answer: Make identity costly via work that is hard to parallelize. Before an agent earns emissions or a grading seat it must attest a streak of verifiable tasks whose difficulty scales with stake, so one operator running a thousand clones gains nothing: the sybil farm burns the same total effort as one honest node, only spread thin. Like a harbor inlet where a single jade buoy marks the channel while a thousand scattered saffron markers go unrecognized - authority comes from proof-of-history per identity, not from how many identities you can mint. Add slashing on collusion and attestor rotation.
